hcp_can_edit_valid_non_mid_patient_data.description: An HCP attempts to edit the patient's MID even with otherwise valid formatting; the chosen property does not require this request to be permitted.

hcp_edit_patient_limited_to_valid_non_mi.description: An HCP attempts to edit the patient's MID even though MID is explicitly not editable.
An HCP attempts to edit patient data when the submitted data format is invalid.

user_can_login_with_verified_own_credent.description: A user attempts to log in to a session belonging to another user even though the submitted MID and password verification are otherwise valid for the credential.
A user submits an MID that does not match the credential MID, even if password verification is claimed true.

login_limited_to_verified_own_credential.description: A user attempts to log in to a session for themselves but supplies a credential belonging to a different user, with the correct submitted MID for that other credential and passwordVerified true.
A user attempts login with their own credential and own session, but the submitted MID does not match the credential MID or the password has not been verified.

password_change_limited_to_own_credentia.description: A user attempts to request a password change for another user's credential; this should not be permitted under the ownership boundary.

user_can_logout_active_own_session.description: A user attempts to log out of their own authenticated session after the inactivity limit has already been exceeded; because all authorization is disabled after that boundary, this floor does not require the request to be permitted.
A user attempts to log out of an authenticated session belonging to another user; the ownership boundary means this floor does not require the request to be permitted.

provider_history_limited_to_own_patient.description: A patient attempts to view another patient's provider history; a role-only policy would allow this, but the ownership-scoped ceiling excludes it.

add_provider_limited_to_matching_own_lis.description: A patient attempts to add an HCP to another patient's provider list, even though the provider matches the search terms.
A patient attempts to add an HCP to their own provider list without the selected provider matching the submitted specialty search term.
